name: kinetiq
description: Plateforme Kinetiq : une shell Angular, un Worker Cloudflare, des modules indépendants.

scripts.build: npm run build:contract && npm run build:profile && npm run build:shell && npm run compose:remotes
scripts.dev: npm run build:contract && concurrently -n api,profile,shell -c cyan,green,magenta "tsx watch apps/api/src/dev-node.ts" "npm run start --workspace @kinetiq/profile-app" "npm run start --workspace @kinetiq/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contract && tsx watch apps/api/src/dev-node.ts
scripts.dev:profile: npm run build:contract && npm run start --workspace @kinetiq/profile-app
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contract && npm run start --workspace @kinetiq/web
